rendered: In the section on regulatory elements for engineering S. marcescens, the review states that Pan et al. identified 32 endogenous promoters from strain JNB5–1, establishing the first constitutive promoter library for this species[1]. This promoter library is presented as part of the genetic engineering and synthetic biology toolkit summarized in Fig. 6[2], alongside work by Liu et al. on endogenous stationary-phase promoters in a different strain, HBQA7[3].
